events.title: Gordon Strachan, who was due to depart as 사우샘프턴 manager at the end of the season, resigned from the club with immediate effect.
Paul Sturrock departed from Division Two leaders 플리머스 아가일 to become 사우샘프턴's new manager.
Three 레스터 시티 players – Paul Dickov , Keith Gillespie and Frank Sinclair – were charged with sexual assault while on a training camp in La Manga , Spain.
A brace from Malky Mackay followed up by a goal from Darren Huckerby secured East Anglian derby victory for 노리치 시티 over 입스위치 타운.
레알 사라고사 beat 레알 마드리드 in the Copa del Rey final 3-2 after extra time.

아스널, the first team to complete 30 matches unbeaten at the start of a league season, led 첼시 by seven points with 맨체스터 유나이티드 a further five points behind. They were also in contention for both the Champions League and the FA Cup. 리버풀 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 completed the top five as Charlton's bid for a European place was fading fast, the competition now coming from Birmingham and 애스턴 빌라 . At the other end of the table, time was running out for 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and Leeds; 레스터 시티 were still giving the rest of the bottom ten a good run for their money. 노리치 시티 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 were equal on points at the top of Division One, and 밀월 had edged 위건 애슬레틱 out of the top six.
